newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance to buy certain P&G fragrances.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance to buy certain P&G fragrances.

text.p: Renaissance Cosmetics Inc said on Wednesday its Dana Perfumes Corp unit has agreed to buy certain mass fragrance brands from Procter & Gamble Co for an undisclosed amount.
The company said it plans to buy the brands Procter & Gamble said in June it wanted to divest. The fragrances include "NaVy," "Insignia" and "Le Jardin."
The company said the fragrances not included in this transaction are "Old Spice," "Henry M. Betrix" and a few other regional brands which Procter & Gamble will continue to manage.
The deal is expected to close by the end of the year.
